QA fix (qa/qa-report-20260813_1.md F7): re-authored off the original 子育て・家族 draw (ベビー用品店:レンタルサービスの説明), which repeated 20260812_2's 聴解問題5-1番 theme (子育て・家族) under exam-blueprint rule 4's zero-tolerance clause for the immediately-previous paper. Recomposed onto a home sleep-aid rental scenario (工事の音対策の快眠グッズ). 睡眠・健康 does not appear in either 20260812_2's or 20260812_1's headline sets, and while it repeats this paper's own 問題10(3) theme, that is permitted by exam-blueprint's rule 2 (headline-vs-reading distinctness governs reading headlines only; listening headlines are governed by rule 3's ≤5 cap alone) — of the 5 themes left after excluding this paper's own headline set and both prior papers' headline sets, only 地域活性化 (used for the paired 聴解問題5-2番 fix) was unused anywhere else in this paper, so one of the two new themes had to reuse a non-headline surface's theme; 睡眠・健康 was chosen as the least disruptive option. Key unchanged (聴解_問題5[0]=4).

Follow-up QA fix (same round, qa/qa-report-20260813_1.md F1/F7, rebuild agent's close reading): the theme fix above still shipped the same 'sequential elimination of N candidates down to 1' decision structure as 20260812_1's own 聴解問題5-1番 (friends narrowing trip destinations one by one) — a same-slot archetype repeat one test apart, undetected by any mechanical check. Re-authored the DECISION STRUCTURE (theme 睡眠・健康 and all four rental-item candidates unchanged): the couple now briefly waves off two candidates as a group, quickly commits to a third (耳栓, the cheapest) as if the choice were settled, then a piece of NEW INFORMATION (a review noting earplugs do not block low-frequency noise) reverses that pick, landing on ホワイトノイズマシン (whose own review specifically praises handling low-frequency noise) — a commit-then-reverse-on-new-information arc, not a checklist-style one-by-one narrowing. Key unchanged (聴解_問題5[0]=4).
